scope:
Fresh Journey: actual shipping UI/input/renderer in both build formats.
Controlled saved-game fixtures and a fault-injectable in-memory storage adapter.
The adapter exercises save/reload code paths, not a real hosted localStorage origin.
No human playtest, native-device or external studio certification is implied.

tests.name: New player retains one-click Play; no unsolicited popup or duplicate restart
Returning player sees Continue first and an explicit Chapter 1 option in the main actions
Confirmation names the replaced checkpoint, explains what stays, and defaults to cancel
Cancel by button keeps every save byte and restores focus to the entry choice
Cancel by escape keeps every save byte and restores focus to the entry choice
Cancel by close keeps every save byte and restores focus to the entry choice
Cancel by enter keeps every save byte and restores focus to the entry choice
Confirmation traps keyboard focus and never defaults Enter to the destructive action
classic: actual confirm starts Chapter 1, resets only the attempt and retains all collections/BEST
relaxed: actual confirm starts Chapter 1, resets only the attempt and retains all collections/BEST
maniac: actual confirm starts Chapter 1, resets only the attempt and retains all collections/BEST
Actual confirmation makes one complete checkpoint write with no deletion window
Duplicate or stale fresh-start events cannot restart an already-running campaign
A stale confirmation after cancellation is inert
Continue still resumes the exact old chapter/score/seed without starting over
After starting again, main-menu Continue clearly points to Chapter 1
Restart → Chapters → Chapter 12 practice → Continue returns to the fresh campaign, with no relock
Starting again preserves existing unlocks but does not unlock unearned chapters
Replaying Chapter 1 with worse mastery advances the new checkpoint without downgrading old stars
Late-chapter practice clear/retry never replaces the restarted campaign checkpoint
Completed campaign without a checkpoint can restart while all 48 chapters and Endless stay unlocked
A saved Chapter 48 run is replaced only after explicit confirmation, never its unlocks
Restarting Classic leaves Relaxed and Maniac checkpoints untouched
Entry choices follow the selected difficulty without affecting another difficulty’s progress
An obsolete confirmation cannot silently restart a different difficulty
Cancel from game-over returns to that result, retaining Retry and avoiding duplicate records
Cancel from Records restores the originating screen and live paused input, not the menu
Five fresh journeys retain lifetime data and produce distinct randomized attempts
Real export/import and full app relaunch from a serialized adapter preserve new checkpoint and old mastery
Older compatible saves without the newer PB collections still expose safe restart
Invalid save import neither resets existing progress nor changes Continue
Save denial is disclosed; old persisted bytes survive and current-session unlocks remain usable
No clock, score or spell state moves while the restart question is open
Modified Escape does not accidentally accept or cancel the question
